## Highlights
### New
- Choose how much customization Crest shows with three styles: Heraldic keeps every control, while Modern and Simple show fewer, simpler ones and keep the rest under Advanced. Pick one in Settings › Appearance or during setup, and give any Space its own. Space icons in the switcher can now be dots. The address field and pins now look the same on every Space, and text over a Space's colors is easier to read.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
